sourcePerformanceBudget.policy: All existing N10-01 thresholds unchanged; this revision adds art-resource ceilings, never relaxes frame/memory/start/thermal/battery gates.

proposedArtResourceCeilings.textureAccounting: RGBA8 decoded width*height*4; includes mipmaps/temporary texture overlap if enabled; excludes framebuffer/native process memory which must be reported separately under existing N10 gates.
proposedArtResourceCeilings.fpsFrameTimeRule: Existing activeFrameP95Ms33.4 unchanged; art review never grants physical PASS.

scope: Targets for initial full room and20observed avatars, not measured capability or supported-device floor. Actual packed atlas/build/process measurements required in N06-09/N10-04.
changePolicy: Retain revision1 after measurement; changes require new revision/reason and fresh results, never overwrite failed results.
